description: Monte Carlo connector (read-only). Indexes Monte Carlo data-quality incidents as `montecarlo:data_quality_test` items in the local index and exposes three read-only tools to the Nimbus agent (`montecarlo_list`, `montecarlo_get`, `montecarlo_search`). Uses the Monte Carlo GraphQL API at `api.getmontecarlo.com` with API key pair auth (x-mcd-id / x-mcd-token headers). The gateway injects `MONTECARLO_API_ID` and `MONTECARLO_API_TOKEN` at spawn time. No write tools.
author: Nimbus
